title: Fix stale 'flagged as BUG (no UI lock)' header comment in parent_pending_redemptions_screen_l1_test.dart
rule: Documentation must not contradict the code/tests it sits beside

evidence.quote: ///   - Double-tap guard: tapping Approve twice — flagged as BUG (no UI lock).
// guard: _RedemptionCard disables Fulfil/Decline (_busy) while the async is

why: The file's own header (line 12) claims Approve double-tap is an open, un-guarded bug, but parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart:199-207/263/286 has a `_busy` flag disabling both Fulfil and Decline while an operation is in flight, and this same test file's later comment (lines 588-594) correctly describes that guard. A maintainer skimming only the header would believe there's live unfixed work here or file a duplicate bug report.
recommendation: Update the header bullet to describe the _busy guard instead of the stale 'flagged as BUG' claim, matching lines 588-594.
acceptance_criteria: Header comment at the top of the file no longer claims an unguarded double-tap bug on Approve.
